exposure: body weight to gestational age LGA
cohort: Neonates born to Qatari women in 2017
finding: Infants born to mothers with pre-pregnancy or gestational diabetes had increased birth weight and prevalence of macrosomia compared to infants of non-diabetic mothers.
mod_finding: While the study does not directly compare different modes of delivery, it finds that cesarean section is significantly associated with an increased risk of gestational diabetes.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight in grams: Control: 3066.01 ± 603.42, GDM: 3156.73 ± 577.88, Pre-pregnancy DM: 3048.78 ± 677.98
Macrosomia (Birth weight > 4000 gm): Control: 2.7%, GDM: 4.8%, Pre-pregnancy DM: 4.6%
